notes: Modified cash basis school district, newly merged (beginning balances all zero). Governmental amounts use the Total Governmental Funds column on p6 (Exhibit D right half, after Reclassifications); p5 is the left half. Receipts printed total 24,184,442.09 includes issuance of bonds 2,035,000.00 (debt_proceeds) and cash balance from dissolved district 9,489,414.16 (other_financing, a special item on p2). Roll: 0 + 12,660,027.93 receipts + 2,035,000 + 9,489,414.16 - 13,042,644.86 = 11,141,797.23. Taxes: Other 3,177,413.36 split using fund schedules (carline vs homestead, property tax credit, pro-rate motor vehicle); penalties and interest are inside Property. Other student support 765,328.66 split into school nutrition (p14) and remainder assumed activities. School nutrition and cooperative funds are in governmental funds in this report, so kept governmental. Transfers: the 60,000 transfer and the 325,000 General-to-Depreciation allocation are eliminated by Reclassifications; the Total column already nets them. In detail the General Fund Exhibit G lines still contain the 325,000 (150,000 from operation and maintenance lines, 175,000 from transportation lines per Exhibit F p8): contra lines and an other financing line (-325,000) were added; Depreciation Fund shows +325,000. General Fund spending detail: Exhibit O (object detail, pp18-19) is used for programs 1100 through 2151 (all fully shown); the trimmed PDF stops partway through Exhibit O after program 2151, so programs 2152 onward come from the Exhibit G budget schedule as 'not itemized'. Exhibit G revenue lines are recorded in full; Exhibit F (General Fund components) duplicates the fund schedules and is not recorded in detail. Student activities fund schedule and any other nonmajor fund schedules (Other Governmental Funds also hold student activities 239,668) are not in the trimmed PDF. Exhibit G zero lines (1300 summer school 0.00, 2183, 9000 non-program) omitted. Balance sheet from Exhibit A (p1). Read pages 1-19 of 19
